responsibility: Implements the out-of-line tree_vector_builder operations used to construct VECTOR_CST nodes from encoded element patterns. In particular it defines how stepped integral elements are materialized for tree constants and how the builder finalizes its accumulated representation into an allocated GCC vector constant with the requested vector type and encoded layout, complementing the template/interface logic declared in tree-vector-builder.h.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line implementation side of tree_vector_builder declared in tree-vector-builder.h, specifically materializing stepped integer elements and allocating/copying the finished encoded data into a VECTOR_CST; unlike the header, it does not define the class interface, traits, or inline pattern-handling helpers.
